record.question: Why salt was chosen as the central formula for the Civil Disobedience Movement?
options: Salt in a flash linked the ideal of Swaraj with almost concrete and universal grievance of the rural poor.
Salt afforded a paltry but psychologically important income like Khadi, for the poor through self help group
It offered to the urban adherents the opportunity of a symbolic identification with mass suffering
